snippet.title: They Found Noah's Ark... What This Means for Atheists?
snippet.description:
What if scientists actually discovered Noah's Ark? Would it change your beliefs about God?

In Turkey, researchers have been investigating a mysterious formation that some believe could be the remains of Noah's Ark. There are claims about unusual underground structures, possible ancient materials, and dimensions resembling those described in the Bible.

But has Noah's Ark really been found? That's for science to establish.

In this video, I'm asking atheists a rather challenging question: What if the scientific evidence eventually proved that Noah's Ark was real? Would you reconsider your beliefs, or would you find another reason to reject God?

And what if your objection wasn't whether God exists, but whether you would want to worship Him?

Comedian Jimmy Carr once spoke about four things that can stand between people and God: fame, fortune, power, and pleasure. Could our personal desires sometimes influence what we're willing to believe?

I'm not claiming Noah's Ark has been discovered. I'm asking what it would mean if it were.

Whether you're an atheist, agnostic, Christian, or simply curious, I'd genuinely like to hear your answer.

If Noah's Ark were conclusively discovered, would it change anything for you? Why or why not?

0:00 The Discovery That Could Change Everything
0:46 Scientific Scrutiny and the Search for Truth
2:10 What Really Keeps Us From Believing?
4:05 Do You Actually Want the Truth?

snippet.title: Makna mendalam mengapa Ronaldo Jr pilih nomor 18 👏🏻
snippet.description:
Ayahnya pun gak pernah pakai nomor 18, ternyata ada makna mendalam mengapa Cristiano Jr. memilih nomor itu di laga debutnya bareng Portugal U-17? Banyak yang mengira itu hanya pilihan acak, tapi padahal tidak, dan itu ada kaitannya dengan ayahnya itu sendiri, yaitu Cristiano Ronaldo. Junior mengejutkan banyak pihak saat menjalani debutnya bersama tim U-17 Portugal. Sebelumnya, ia selalu mengenakan nomor punggung 7, angka ikonik milik ayahnya, baik saat bermain untuk Al-Nassr maupun tim nasional Portugal. Tapi setelah Ronaldo pensiun, Junior tiba-tiba beralih ke nomor 18. Sepanjang kariernya, Ronaldo pernah mengenakan nomor 9 di Madrid, nomor 28 di Sporting, dan nomor 17 di tim nasional Portugal, tetapi ia tidak pernah mengenakan nomor 18. Saat ditanya mengapa, Junior mengungkapkan bahwa ia memilih nomor itu setelah nomor 7 sudah ada yang pakai, jadi ia pilih nomor 18, sebagai penghormatan untuk debut ayahnya karena ayahnya memulai karier bersama tim nasional Portugal di usia 18.

snippet.title: The Truth Behind Japan’s F-15 Intercept Photos
snippet.description:
Chinese military expert Zhang Junshe told Global Times that the WZ-7 reconnaissance drone flies higher than Japan's F-15s carrying weapons and external fuel tanks, and pointed to Japanese photographs as evidence. But what do those photographs actually show?

This video examines Japan's report on the November 2, 2026 WZ-7 flights. In Plain Record's reading, the photographs show the WZ-7 from below. That alone does not establish the altitude gap or whether the drone was beyond an armed fighter's reach. None of the 13 Joint Staff releases reviewed, dated October 14 to November 12, 2026, gives a flight altitude.

The November 11–12 flights between Taiwan and Yonaguni were separate. Japan reported a BZK-005 and presumed Chinese drones of unnamed type.

What do you make of the claim?

Sources:
Japan Joint Staff, November 2 WZ-7 report: https://www.mod.go.jp/js/pdf/2026/p20261102_05.pdf
Global Times, the expert's claim: https://www.globaltimes.cn/page/202611/1373566.shtml
Japan Joint Staff, November 11 drone report: https://www.mod.go.jp/js/pdf/2026/p20261111_03.pdf
Japan Joint Staff, November 12 drone report: https://www.mod.go.jp/js/pdf/2026/p20261112_01.pdf

Footage and images: Japan Joint Staff / JASDF; U.S. Air Force (DVIDS); NASA Worldview / MODIS Terra, November 12, 2026; NASA Blue Marble; NOAA Photo Library.
Music: "Open Road" by Lennon Hutton (Epidemic Sound).
